text: {"assertions":["A flapping flag bug in platform/featureflags/eval.go was identified and fixed on 2026-04-02.","The flapping flag bug only manifested for sessions arriving through the OAuth provider.","The root cause was a missing composite database index on (tenant_id, created_at).","The bug symptom was flag evaluation decisions that alternated between consecutive calls for the same user.","The fix involved adding a composite index on (tenant_id, created_at) and backfilling data in batches.","The fix was submitted as PR #1210 on the branch fix/flapping-flag-1.","The error rate improved from 4.2% to under 0.08% (8 per 10,000) after deploying the fix.","This flapping flag work occurred in the same code section as earlier flapping flag fixes, allowing context to carry over."]}
